data.why: app.py loads batch_data.csv/ground_truth.csv bundled in the repo root; no upload widget exists, the dashboard is read-only over this fixed file.

goals: Spot when the manufacturing process went out of control by reading the I-MR control charts for each quality attribute
Confirm which batches triggered Western Electric / trend rules and see them collapsed into out-of-control episodes with onset and peak severity
Assess process capability (Cpk vs Ppk) across the qualification baseline versus full production to judge whether the process is capable long-term
Rank which process parameters (CPPs) drive dissolution using the XGBoost + SHAP explanatory model, and check the direction of each effect
Cross-check that the ML-identified drivers (API particle size, humidity, compression force) line up with the SPC-flagged episodes to build a root-cause story
Browse and filter individual batches, overlay flags, and export the flagged batch table for further review

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose ('when did the process go out of control, and why') and follows the four tabs as real stages, and every screen I opened shows what its node says. It needs small fixes before filing: add the summary cards, frame capability around the Cpk–Ppk gap, cross-check all three drivers rather than only d90, fix the t4 citations, and slim down the batch-explorer feature.
